title: Profile

rows.apiValue: Tokens for ChatGPT, Claude or a script

language.title: Language
language.intro: What every screen reads in. Your exercises, notes and workout names stay as you typed them.
language.saved: Saved to your account, so every device signed in as you reads the same.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.deviceOnly: Saved on this device only. System follows your phone's setting.

equipment.title: Equipment
equipment.intro: What your gym has, so premade programmes swap in exercises you can do.

unitsPage.title: Units
unitsPage.intro: How every weight is shown and typed: the steppers, the plates, the charts, your bodyweight.
unitsPage.saved: Saved to your account, so every device signed in as you shows the same. What you have already logged is kept as it was and shown in the unit you pick.

export.title: Export
export.intro: One JSON file with every workout, session, set and weigh-in on this device — a backup, and something you can hand to an assistant to read. The shared exercise library is left out; the exercises you added yourself are in.

import.title: Import
import.intro: Read a backup back in. Nothing is deleted: rows in the file are added, or updated where they are already here.
import.otherAccount: This backup is from another account, so its rows come in as new ones here rather than replacing yours. Importing it twice is still safe.
import.imported: Imported {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}.
import.nothingNew: Nothing to import — it is all already here.
import.merged: {count, plural, one {# exercise matched one you already have.} other {# exercises matched ones you already have.}}
import.skipped: {count, plural, one {# row left out — what it belongs to was not in the file.} other {# rows left out — what they belong to was not in the file.}}
import.writeFailed: Something in that backup could not be written. Nothing else was changed.

errors.notBackup: That is not a gymlog backup.
errors.newer: That backup was made by a newer version of gymlog.

counts.sessions: {count, plural, one {# logged workout} other {# logged workouts}}
counts.templateItems: {count, plural, one {# exercise in a workout} other {# exercises in workouts}}
counts.programDays: {count, plural, one {# scheduled day} other {# scheduled days}}
counts.exercises: {count, plural, one {# exercise of your own} other {# exercises of your own}}
counts.exerciseNotes: {count, plural, one {# exercise note} other {# exercise notes}}
